items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I happened to meet Serge Chaloff

ctx.x: And so that to me is a very... it kind of reminded me a little bit of the Howard Theater. On the off nights of course you also... most Monday nights you’d have the Lincoln Colonnades and all those bands would go over there and play for dances. Well, this wasn’t dances, but seems like they also had somewhat of a symbiotic relationship where a lot of these bands or musicians would play there.
Yeah, they’d come there. I happened to meet Serge Chaloff...
